description: Hand-labelled ground truth for the knowledge-base retriever. Each question is phrased the way customers write (not copied from the section titles). 'expected' lists the acceptable passages (document + a substring of the section title; the first one is the best answer). 'scope' is the division the Support Manager would route to ('general' = all documents). Unanswerable questions (answerable=false) are about topics the documents never cover: the retriever must report match_found=false so the ticket goes to a human. split=dev questions were used while tuning the query expansion and the reranker; split=test questions were written afterwards and are reported separately as held-out results.
protocol: dev = the only questions used to tune query expansion, reranker weights and thresholds. test = held-out, written after the query expansion was tuned; frozen by the SHA-256 above - the evaluation reports whether it is unchanged and checks that no held-out question appears in the code or the documents.
